metadata.title: Allee effect (descriptive population model)
metadata.description: One population N, its next value given by an equation describing density dependence: at low density growth falls rather than rises, so a small population can decline to extinction. One of thirteen such equations in the program, each here a model of its own, listed under "Family". Default values are chosen for illustration (the program asks for them). Converted from the TrueBASIC program DESCRPOP.tru on the CD of the book.

paper.citation: Owen-Smith N (2007) Introduction to Modeling in Wildlife and Resource Conservation. Blackwell Publishing, Oxford. ISBN 978-1-4051-4439-1.

family.title: Descriptive population models: thirteen forms of density dependence

members.title: Exponential growth with a ceiling
members.summary: grows by a fixed proportion each year until it reaches K, then stays there

members.title: Logistic
members.summary: growth slows in a straight line as N approaches K; with large r it overshoots, cycles or becomes chaotic

members.title: Ricker
members.summary: like the logistic but never negative; with high r it cycles and becomes chaotic

members.title: Beverton-Holt
members.summary: growth saturates smoothly towards an equilibrium, never overshooting; crowding set by a

members.title: Generalised Beverton-Holt
members.summary: an exponent b sets how sharply crowding takes effect

members.title: Theta-logistic
members.summary: an exponent p sets where density dependence bites: late (p > 1) or early (p < 1)

members.title: Threshold logistic
members.summary: exponential growth below a threshold density A, logistic between A and K

members.title: Lagged logistic
members.summary: crowding judged by the population some years ago, so it overshoots and cycles

members.title: Logistic with cyclic K
members.summary: the carrying capacity swings by half around K over a set period

members.title: Logistic with random K
members.summary: K drawn afresh each year between half and one and a half times its mean

members.title: Theta-logistic with random K
members.summary: the theta-logistic, with K random each year

members.title: Generalised Beverton-Holt with random K
members.summary: the generalised Beverton-Holt, with K random each year

members.title: Allee effect
members.summary: at low density growth falls rather than rises, so a small population can decline to extinction
